# Chris Misztur

> Chris Misztur is the President & Founder of Mr. IIoT, specializing in building Smart Factories, both real and virtual. With over 25 years of experience, he digitally transforms manufacturing through innovative IoT solutions and Industry 4.0 expertise, focusing on identifying inefficiencies and applying cutting-edge technologies.

Chris Misztur, President & Founder of Mr. IIoT, brings over 25 years of experience in industrial digital transformation. Based in the Greater Chicago Area, he is known for his "5C" closed-loop feedback approach to IIoT implementation (Connect, Collect, Combine, Compute, Convey) and for developing the SHARC IoT adapter. His mission is to drive innovation through advanced IoT solutions, enabling businesses and manufacturers to unlock their full potential.
